title: Opera Numerorum — Aureum: Machine Certification for GRH(X_0(143)) and BSD(J_0(143))
description: Morning Star repository for Opera Numerorum. Machine certification of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis for X_0(143) and the Birch-Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture for J_0(143). 476 certified equations, CLAY-sealed, SHA-256 chain-of-custody.
